candidate.scope: AppKit presentation only; existing SDK, saved-data and ontology contracts unchanged

repair.owner: NotebookEditorScrollView.setFrameSize, before the clip/document width changes
repair.geometry: TextKit2 native insertion-segment rectangle plus textContainerOrigin; finite full horizontal and vertical containment in the prior document viewport
repair.eligibility: Only the active, focused editor with an unmarked, empty insertion caret that was already visible
repair.reveal: Native scrollRangeToVisible after synchronous frame change; no queued scrolling or legacy-layout offset conversion
repair.preserved: Intentional offscreen browsing, unfocused/inactive editor, nonempty selection, marked text, rich styles, native Undo/Redo and document content

checks: Native headless AppKit/TextKit2 window and layout with independently measured finite full-X/Y caret containment
Visible end caret remains in the viewport at every width
Old right-edge caret beyond the next narrower width is retained after shrink
Exact text, styles, selection and native formatting/typing Undo/Redo remain intact
Intentional offscreen browsing, unfocused/inactive editor, nonempty selection and active marked text are preserved
Existing rapid edit/stale autosave, external refresh, hidden-pane focus/IME and form-field focus scenarios pass

Expanded right-edge test against insufficient synchronous candidate
